title: Sushi Chef
experience: Previous experience as a Sushi Chef in a reputable restaurant or high-end dining establishment
description_text:
Our client, a prestigious international restaurant specialising in Asian-inspired cuisine, is seeking a talented and experienced Sushi Chef to join its culinary team in St. Julian's, Malta.
 The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing high-quality sushi, sashimi, and other Japanese-inspired dishes while maintaining exceptional standards of presentation, freshness, and food safety.
 This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate culinary professional to showcase their creativity and expertise in a sophisticated, high-end dining environment.
 Key Responsibilities
 Prepare and present a variety of sushi, sashimi, nigiri, maki rolls, and other Japanese specialities.
 Ensure consistency in food quality, taste, presentation, and portion sizes.
 Select, handle, and prepare fresh fish, seafood, and other ingredients according to established standards.
 Maintain excellent standards of hygiene, food safety, and cleanliness in the sushi preparation area.
 Monitor ingredient freshness, stock levels, and proper storage procedures.
 Assist with menu development, seasonal specials, and creative sushi presentations.
 Ensure efficient preparation and timely service during busy restaurant operations.
 Work closely with the Head Chef and kitchen team to maintain high culinary standards.
 Minimise food waste and support effective stock management.
 Ensure compliance with HACCP procedures and food safety regulations.
 Requirements
 Previous experience as a Sushi Chef in a reputable restaurant or high-end dining establishment. 
 Strong knowledge of Japanese cuisine, sushi preparation techniques, and seafood handling.
 Excellent knife skills and attention to detail.
 Ability to prepare sushi and sashimi to consistently high standards.
 Good understanding of food hygiene, HACCP, and safe food handling procedures.
 Creativity and passion for Japanese and Asian-inspired cuisine.
 Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a fast-paced kitchen.
 Strong teamwork, organisational, and communication skills.
 Good command of English.
 Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
 What Our Client Offers
 Opportunity to work within a prestigious international restaurant concept.
 A professional and dynamic culinary environment.
 Exposure to high-end Asian-inspired cuisine and international culinary standards.
 Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
 Are you a passionate Sushi Chef looking to showcase your skills in an exceptional dining environment? Apply today and take the next step in your culinary career!
